body: docs/review-2026-11-12.md item 0.1. segments() in packages/core/src/services/shell-changes.ts skips backslash handling inside double quotes, so \" ends the quote early.

completion.releaseNote: guard: a command after an escaped quote is now checked
completion.summary: segments() in shell-changes.ts now consumes the character after a backslash inside double quotes too, so \" no longer ends the quote early and a later rm or git push --no-verify is split and checked. Single-quote handling unchanged. Test: "an escaped quote inside a double-quoted string does not hide a later rm" (3 failing inputs + 1 control).
